name: Amen Jungle Break
desc: Chopped amen break rolled over two cycles with every-bar re-slice and reverse fills, reinforced by a 909 backbeat — the jungle engine from full_show (clean:2 rebuilt onto a legal named break).

code.full: stack(s("amen").loopAt(2).chop(${chop}).every(4, x => x.fast(2)).every(8, x => x.chop(32).rev()).shape(${drive}).room(.12).gain(${gain}), s("~ ~ sd ~ ~ [~ sd] sd ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*.6).room(.2), s("hh*16").bank("RolandTR909").gain(saw.range(${gain}*.1, ${gain}*.4).fast(4)).pan(sine.range(.3,.7).slow(3)).lpf(${cut}).room(.1)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("amen").loopAt(2).chop(${chop}).every(4, x => x.fast(2)).every(7, x => x.chop(32).rev()).every(11, x => x.ply(2)).shape(${drive}*1.3).room(.1).gain(${gain}), s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~ ~ bd ~ [bd ~]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*.9).shape(.3), s("hh*16").bank("RolandTR909").gain("[.4 .1 .25 .08]*4").pan(sine.range(.2,.8).slow(2)).lpf(${cut}).room(.08), s("~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ride").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*.4).room(.3)).orbit(1).play()
